nodes.name: Epic Poetry
nodes.description: Long narrative poems recounting the deeds of heroes and the founding of peoples.

nodes.name: Lyric Poetry
nodes.description: Short poems expressing personal emotion, often originally sung to the lyre.

nodes.name: Narrative Poetry
nodes.description: Poetry that tells a story through verse.

nodes.name: Sonnet
nodes.description: A fourteen-line lyric poem in fixed meter and rhyme scheme.

nodes.name: Haiku
nodes.description: A Japanese three-line poem of seventeen syllables evoking a moment in nature.

nodes.name: Tanka
nodes.description: A classical Japanese five-line poem of thirty-one syllables.

nodes.name: Sijo
nodes.description: A Korean three-line lyrical verse form with a turn in the final line.

nodes.name: Ghazal
nodes.description: A lyrical poem of couplets with a refrain, rooted in Arabic and Persian traditions.

nodes.name: Qasida
nodes.description: A classical Arabic ode of praise, elegy, or satire.

nodes.name: Shi Poetry
nodes.description: Classical Chinese regulated verse with fixed tonal and structural rules.

nodes.name: Ci Poetry
nodes.description: Classical Chinese song lyrics written to existing melodic patterns.

nodes.name: Rubai
nodes.description: A Persian quatrain form of four lines expressing a complete thought.

nodes.name: Novel
nodes.description: A long prose narrative of substantial length depicting characters and action.

nodes.name: Novella
nodes.description: A prose narrative shorter than a novel but longer than a short story.

nodes.name: Short Story
nodes.description: A brief prose narrative focused on a single effect or episode.

nodes.name: Flash Fiction
nodes.description: Extremely brief fiction, often under a thousand words.

nodes.name: Bildungsroman
nodes.description: A novel of formation tracing a protagonist's moral and psychological growth.

nodes.name: Epistolary Novel
nodes.description: A novel told through letters, diaries, or other documents.

nodes.name: Picaresque Novel
nodes.description: A novel following a roguish hero through episodic adventures.

nodes.name: Literary Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction valued for its artistry and depth rather than genre conventions.

nodes.name: Genre Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction organized around recognizable popular genres and conventions.

nodes.name: Science Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction imagining scientific or technological futures and their consequences.

nodes.name: Fantasy
nodes.description: Fiction set in imagined worlds with magic and supernatural elements.

nodes.name: Mystery Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction centered on the solution of a crime or puzzle.

nodes.name: Romance Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction centered on romantic love and its resolution.

nodes.name: Horror Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction intended to frighten and unsettle through the supernatural or grotesque.

nodes.name: Historical Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction set in a specific past period that reconstructs historical settings.

nodes.name: Thriller
nodes.description: Suspense fiction built on tension, danger, and high stakes.

nodes.name: Dystopian Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction depicting oppressive imagined societies as a critique of the present.

nodes.name: Tragedy
nodes.description: Drama depicting the downfall of a protagonist through fate or flaw.

nodes.name: Comedy
nodes.description: Drama aimed at amusement and typically ending in reconciliation.

nodes.name: Tragicomedy
nodes.description: Drama mixing tragic and comic elements.

nodes.name: Farce

nodes.name: Melodrama
nodes.description: Drama appealing to emotion through sensational plots and stock characters.

nodes.name: Verse Drama
nodes.description: Drama written predominantly in verse rather than prose.

nodes.name: Noh

nodes.name: Kabuki

nodes.name: Sanskrit Drama

nodes.name: Kunqu

nodes.name: Essay

nodes.name: Biography
nodes.description: A written account of a person's life by another author.

nodes.name: Autobiography
nodes.description: A person's account of their own life.

nodes.name: Memoir
nodes.description: A personal narrative focused on a period or theme of the author's life.

nodes.name: Travel Writing
nodes.description: Literary accounts of journeys and encounters with other places and peoples.

nodes.name: Nature Writing
nodes.description: Nonfiction exploring the natural world and human relation to it.

nodes.name: Literary Journalism

nodes.name: Narratology

nodes.name: Reader-Response Theory

nodes.name: Ecocriticism

nodes.name: Queer Theory
